title: Seniors: keep the flat, unlock the cash

lines.say: You're 65, your flat is paid off, and your CPF feels thin. You don't have to move to unlock cash.
It's the Lease Buyback Scheme. You sell part of your remaining lease back to HDB.
lines.cap: sell *part of your lease* back to HDB

lines.say: At 65 to 69, you keep at least 30 years. Older owners can keep less.
The proceeds top up your CPF retirement account, for a monthly CPF LIFE payout.
lines.cap: top up CPF for a *monthly payout*

lines.say: A 3 room or smaller can get a bonus of up to 30,000 dollars.
And you can keep up to 100,000 dollars as cash.

source: HDB. Top-up depends on age and number of owners.
caption:
65, flat paid off, CPF feels thin? You don't have to move to unlock cash. 🏠

The Lease Buyback Scheme lets you sell part of your remaining lease back to HDB. At 65 to 69 you keep at least 30 years; older owners can keep less. The proceeds top up your CPF retirement account for a monthly CPF LIFE payout. 3 room or smaller can get a bonus of up to $30,000, and you can keep up to $100,000 as cash.

Useful info? Follow for more 👇

Top-up amounts depend on age and number of owners. Full rules on HDB.
